note: Legal entity HPL ELECTRIC & POWER LIMITED is a listed Indian company (BSE scrip 540136 per BSE URL path; CIN not verified from a primary registry page in this session, so left unstated). Export shipments are factual, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code exist (Kenya 2025-11-28 B/L 3331741; plus recurring Bhutan, UAE, Nigeria, Saudi Arabia buyer lanes). Important HS caveat per project rule 3: the declared codes 853225/853620 are confirmed only on the IMPORT side (85362030 MCB from Shanghai, B/L 4909578, 2025-09-30); the visible EXPORT line carries HS 49111010. The company does manufacture and ship switchgear/MCB-class goods, so 853620 is plausible for exports, but no export B/L with 853225 or 853620 was visible in the free view — recommend correcting/confirming the export HS code against a paid record rather than rejecting. Domestic supply: confirmed by listed-company audited reporting and an Indian consignee relationship, though the specific GST turnover band and GeM/CPPP contract IDs remain unverified due to search tool outage. No grounds for rejection.
